decisions.reason: Changing the arrangement from 5-and-3 to 4-and-4 does not alter the already established eight-badge catalog or Legend exclusion.
The grid-layout change does not alter badge triggers, milestone thresholds, or award destinations.
The source separately approves NFT size and the View Book button, but the badge-grid decision does not change NFT asset presentation state.
The badge-grid arrangement is unrelated to landing-page hero copy and layout.
The presentation change does not revise the mission page's badge or gamification copy.
A dashboard badge-grid arrangement does not affect landing-page book-cover placement, size, crop, or visibility.
The badge-grid layout does not alter NFT metadata ticket counters or other reward attributes.
The source does not change the About page's gamification copy or any other About-page content.
Badge-grid presentation has no effect on the optional offline PDF download behavior or link presentation.
The badge-grid change does not alter the public next-draw sales counter.
Rearranging displayed badges does not change whether earned badges or other NFT state transfer to a purchaser.
The badge-grid arrangement does not affect whether the dashboard lists only successfully minted NFTs.
